title: Enterprise Request Scoring for Pricing & Billing Extensions
creator: Priya Desai
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable scoring and routing framework to triage incoming enterprise requests related to pricing, commitments, invoicing, and marketplace credits. The goal is to reduce time-to-decision, increase consistency across AE/CS intake, and provide clear handoffs to Finance, Legal, and Engineering. This ticket produces: (1) a scoring rubric with weights and examples, (2) routing matrix for next owner and SLA, and (3) a documented ‘fast-path’ for high-value commitment negotiations vs standard billing exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric published in Confluence with weights and worked examples
Routing matrix merged into Intake playbook and linked from AE/CS intake form
2 training sessions scheduled with Sales Ops and CS (recording stored)
Automated labels and route suggestions prototyped in Linear/Forms for pilot region
comments: 2025-02-10 Priya Desai: Kickoff note — collated common request types from last 12 months (commitment discounts, invoicing cadence changes, marketplace offsets). Need input from Finance on threshold for sign-off vs escalation.
2025-02-11 Maya Thompson (Finance): Shared finance thresholds doc (link below). Suggests using ARR uplift + legal complexity as primary axes.

2025-02-12 Alex Kim: Drafted initial scoring factors: ARR delta, contract term change, accounting impact, implementation effort, legal risk, marketplace revenue recognition complexity. Proposed weights: ARR 30%, Legal 20%, Implementation 15%, Accounting 15%, Strategic Value 10%, Customer Risk 10%.

2025-02-13 Product review: PMs asked to drop Implementation effort weight to 10% to keep emphasis on commercial value. Engineering flagged that some changes carry infra cost >$50k which needs higher weight — added ‘Engineering cost override’ flag to rubric.
2025-02-14 Sales Ops feedback: Requested fast-path for deals >$200k ARR for VP-level pre-approval instead of full Finance queue. Added to routing matrix.
2025-02-14 Alex Kim: Marking prototype for automated route suggestions in Linear forms — working with ENG-19876 to add a webhook that maps scores to owner queues.
decision_logs: 2025-02-12: Adopt weighted scoring across six axes (see description). Rationale: balances strategic value with measurable financial impact and operational cost.
2025-02-13: Engineering cost override added as boolean flag when expected infra or SRE work exceeds $50k. Rationale: prevents under-prioritization of high-cost items.

2025-02-14: Fast-path established for >$200k ARR requests to be routed to VP-Sales for pre-approval. Rationale: speed commercial negotiation for high-value deals while preserving Finance oversight post-approval.
Open: Decide threshold for marketplace credit exceptions where tax/accounting treatment changes — awaiting Legal guidance (target 2025-02-21).
